Grounded incidence B, W=diag(w), L=BWB^T, unit load f, u=L^(-1)f, z=B^T u, c=f^T L^(-1)f. The normalized cycle projector Pi=I-W^(1/2)B^T L^(-1)B W^(1/2) gives Gamma=W^(-1/2)Pi W^(-1/2). For selected S and D=diag[(1-d_e)/(d_e w_e)], M=Gamma_SS+D is PSD. Existing low-rank/outage algebra gives c_d=c+z_S^T M^+ z_S if z_S is in range(M), infinity otherwise. The claimed advance is preserving this singular geometry under compressed finite preprocessing, not inventing Woodbury, cycle duality, static resistance sketching or nearly linear Laplacian solvers.

A random sign sketch Y0=R Pi W^(-1/2) with q rows embeds every sparse support subspace simultaneously by net/union bound. For each row, approximate a~W^(1/2)r and solve Lv~Ba; spanning-tree routing BT=I repairs j=a-WB^T v-T(Ba-Lv), so Bj=0 exactly on stored finite values. Store dyadic physical flows j, performing j_e/w_e division rationally at query time. With E=(Y-Y0)W^(1/2), exact circulation gives E=E Pi. Thus operator error yields relative error against x^T Gamma x and exact zeros on its nullspace, rather than an unprotected absolute floor. No damaged-graph eigenvalue lower bound is used.

The baseline current also needs exact conservation: jhat=WB^T v+T(f-Lv), Bjhat=f. Energy excess<=eta^2 c implies, for e_S=(W^(-1)jhat-z)_S, e_S lies in range(Gamma_SS) and e_S^T Gamma_SS^+ e_S<=eta^2 c. Since M>=Gamma_SS, this bounds every damaged inverse correction without a reciprocal spectral gap and preserves the correct singular consistency test. PSD relative bounds survive adding D. A stored scalar chat approximates the repaired positive energy, not an independently rounded infeasible load.

Online: read selected columns/flows, form Mhat=Y_S^T Y_S+D, solve Mhat x=zhat_S with exact rational elimination; return infinity if inconsistent, otherwise chat+zhat_S^T x rounded to output precision. Initial dyadic weights approximate every positive weight multiplicatively; using them consistently preserves all damaged connectivity and energy comparisons. Tree amplification C_T=1+n sqrt(2m rho), rho=wmax/wmin, determines reference solve tolerance; a grounded residual bound lambda_min(L)>=wmin/n^2 certifies accuracy. Working precision depends logarithmically on n,m,rho,q,epsilon^-1 and on input bit lengths, not on a numerical inverse retained conductance. Expected preprocessing bit work is O-tilde(mq) poly(b_in), including sparse/tree operations and repeated certified solver calls. Query bit work O(qk^2+k^3) poly(k,b_work+b_d) pays for damage-fraction encoding. The mq independent random signs, solver randomness, memory, input reads and outputs are charged. Exhaustive support verification is not free; uniform correctness is probabilistic.

For N_scen supplied scenarios, arithmetic is O-tilde(mk/epsilon^2+N_scen k^3/epsilon^2), plus bit/input/output costs. The scientific application is repeated contact-network calculations for a supplied conductive-composite model, not acquisition or validation of that material model. Competent comparators are near-linear solves per damaged network, cached selected-inverse updates, dense m^2 interaction storage, favorable low-cycle outage methods and a distinct monotone partially dynamic all-pairs interface. No separation from all specialized implementations or measured performance superiority is established. Given an actual scenario sampler, estimating F=c/c_d (zero if infinite) to additive a costs O(a^-2 log(1/zeta)) sampled queries with sketch accuracy O(a); query work may scale O-tilde(k^3 a^-4), besides preprocessing and sampling. No free combinatorial damage search is implied.

Counterexamples: false Gram nullspace floors conceal diverging resistance and can falsely report finite connectivity; a nonconserving approximate load yields >1e54 relative error in the displayed triangle with true resistance near one. Exact repairs retain the cut constraints. Recovered checks are dense rational/numerical diagnostics, not a production sparse implementation. The scope excludes arbitrary strengthening, evolving cumulative damage, variable terminal pairs, nonlinear constitutive laws, mechanical fracture, hidden conductance/damage inference and inexpensive full-current output. Earlier N710 is research context only, not a dependency. Independent universal proof/priority reconstruction, actual asymptotic implementation, matched performance and physical acquisition remain open.
